items.name: action-search-bar
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: ⌘K command palette with nested pages, fuzzy matching and in-row progress for running actions.

items.name: activity-terrain
items.title: Activity Terrain
items.description: A contribution heatmap that tilts up into a 3D terrain you can turn, built with React and canvas.

items.name: ai-agent-lanes
items.title: AI Agent Lanes
items.description: A lead agent hands work to sub-agents that run side by side. Each gets a lane of tool calls, and you can scrub through the whole run.

items.name: ai-autocomplete
items.title: AI Autocomplete
items.description: A text box that suggests how your sentence ends in grey after the caret. Tab takes it all, the right arrow takes one word, and typing the same letters keeps it.

items.name: ai-branches
items.title: AI Conversation Branches
items.description: A chat where editing a message starts a new branch. A small tree beside it shows every version, and you can jump between them.

items.name: ai-citations
items.title: AI Inline Citations
items.description: An answer with source chips beside each claim. One preview glides between chips and lights up the sentence it backs.

items.name: ai-context-meter
items.title: AI Context Meter
items.description: How full the context window is, as a ring in the prompt footer that opens a breakdown by source and compacts when it fills.

items.name: ai-diff-review
items.title: AI Diff Review
items.description: A coding agent's edits streaming in file by file, then reviewed per file with accept, reject and undo.

items.name: ai-inline-edit
items.title: AI Inline Edit
items.description: Select text in a document and ask AI to rewrite it. The edit streams in place as a word-level diff you accept, discard or try again.

items.name: ai-input-search
items.title: AI Input Search
items.description: AI composer with a Tools menu of modes (browse, investigate, draft a visual, run code, reason), a tool header with a Change key, a model picker, an Ask key and a live trace that stacks each source's avatar as it is read. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

items.name: ai-loading
items.title: AI State Loading
items.description: Agent progress as a list of steps with a live log, elapsed time and a summary when done.

items.name: ai-memory
items.title: AI Memory
items.description: An assistant that saves what it learns about you into a memory list. New facts replace the ones they contradict, and you can edit or forget any of them.

items.name: ai-message-queue
items.title: AI Message Queue
items.description: Keep typing while the agent works. Follow-ups stack above the composer, where you can reorder, edit or send one now, and go in one by one when the run ends.

items.name: ai-model-selector
items.title: AI Model Selector
items.description: Pick a model and how hard it thinks. Effort is a detent track that reshapes for each model and keeps your level when you switch.

items.name: ai-prompt
items.title: AI Input Selector
items.description: AI chat input with a model menu, a separate Effort control, file chips you can drop or paste, a / command menu, and Stop while replying.

items.name: ai-redact
items.title: AI Redact
items.description: Names, emails, card numbers and keys are masked as placeholders before a prompt is sent. Replies come back with the placeholders and are filled in with the real values.

items.name: ai-text-loading
items.title: AI Text Loading
items.description: AI thinking text with a soft wave through the letters and words that swap letter by letter.

items.name: ai-token-alternatives
items.title: AI Token Alternatives
items.description: An answer where every unsure word shows what else the model weighed. Pick another word and the reply writes itself again from there.

items.name: ai-tool-approval
items.title: AI Tool Approval
items.description: Approve or deny an agent's tool calls. Destructive calls need a press and hold, and decided calls fold into a trace with their output.

items.name: ai-voice
items.title: AI Voice
items.description: Voice input with a scrolling waveform, then a take you can play back, discard or send.

items.name: amount-pad
items.title: Amount Pad
items.description: A keypad for sending money. Digits spring into place, commas slide them along, and the amount shrinks to fit as it grows.

items.name: apple-activity-card
items.title: Apple Activity Card
items.description: Activity rings that draw with a count-up, lap past 100% with a shadowed end cap and dim to focus, built with React and Motion.

items.name: attract-button
items.title: Magnet Button
items.description: A call-to-action button wrapped in a field of iron filings that align to its magnetic field and lean toward your cursor.

items.name: avatar-picker
items.title: Avatar Picker
items.description: Generated avatars from a name, morphing as you type, on a 3D coin you can flick, tap or shuffle.

items.name: background-paths
items.title: Background Paths
items.description: A ribbon of lines in one color that keeps flowing at any size and parts around the cursor.

items.name: bell-button
items.title: Bell Button
items.description: A subscribe button whose bell swings and rings, with a clapper that really strikes.

items.name: bento-grid
items.title: Widget Grid
items.description: Dashboard widgets you lift, drag and resize on a 6-column grid, with spring physics and full keyboard support.

items.name: boarding-pass
items.title: Boarding Pass
items.description: A boarding pass that keeps itself current. When the gate or times change, only the characters that moved roll over, and the old value stays underneath, struck through.

items.name: card-field
items.title: Card Field
items.description: A one-row card input for checkout. The number groups the way the brand prints it, then slides away to its last four digits to make room for expiry and security code.

items.name: card-flip
items.title: Flick Card
items.description: A two-sided card you spin with a drag or a flick, with thickness, light and a floor shadow that follow the angle.

items.name: card-stack
items.title: Throw Deck
items.description: A pile of image cards you drag, flick off the top and send under the deck, with arrow keys and a details view.

items.name: carousel-cards
items.title: Momentum Rail
items.description: A card rail you flick with momentum, snapping on a spring, with scroll-driven cover-flow depth and parallax.

items.name: cart-button
items.title: Cart Button
items.description: An Add button that opens into a quantity stepper in place, with a bin at one and press-and-hold to repeat.

items.name: caustics-background
items.title: Caustics Background
items.description: A hero on the floor of a pool. Light ripples across it, clicks drop rings that bend the light, and the headline floats on the surface with its shadow wobbling below.

items.name: clip-trimmer
items.title: Clip Trimmer
items.description: A video trim timeline with a filmstrip, handles that snap to whole seconds and a playhead that loops the kept range.

items.name: command-button
items.title: Command Button
items.description: A button with its shortcut drawn as keycaps that sink as you press the real keys.

items.name: contact-sheet
items.title: Contact Sheet
items.description: Pick from a shoot the way photographers do. Circle a frame in china marker, click again to strike it, and look through a loupe at the detail first.

items.name: cradle-text
items.title: Cradle Text
items.description: A headline hung like a Newton's cradle, so a knock on one letter clacks through the word, built with React and pendulum physics.

items.name: currency-transfer
items.title: Currency Transfer
items.description: Transfer tracker that converts the amount in place, walks through each step on a filling rail, and ends with a copyable reference. Built with React and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: detent-dial
items.title: Detent Dial
items.description: Rotary knob that clicks from notch to notch and coasts when flicked, built with React and Motion.

items.name: dot-field
items.title: Dot Field
items.description: A halftone dot membrane that ripples behind a swipe and rings out from a click, built with React and Canvas.

items.name: drape-background
items.title: Drape Background
items.description: A pleated curtain in a breeze that you can push and pull, built with React, WebGL and a cloth simulation.

items.name: dynamic-text
items.title: Dynamic Text
items.description: Morphing text where shared letters travel, old ones fall and new ones land, with decode and cycle modes.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: A multi-file upload queue with per-file progress, retry and cancel.

items.name: flow-field
items.title: Wind
items.description: Streamlines that part around the cursor, swirl in its wake and scatter on click, built with React and Canvas.

items.name: focal-point-picker
items.title: Focal Point Picker
items.description: Set where a photo's subject is and see every crop follow it live. Hover a crop to see what it cuts.

items.name: glitch-text
items.title: Glitch Text
items.description: Flat text that cuts into hard-shifted bands with a thin red/cyan split, on idle, hover or text change.

items.name: gradient-button
items.title: Gradient Button
items.description: Layered gradient button with emerald, purple, and orange variants, a gradient border in light and dark mode, soft inner glow, press feedback, and an optional icon, styled entirely with Tailwind CSS in React.

items.name: halftone-background
items.title: Halftone Background
items.description: Any image, or a lit sphere, printed as a halftone dot screen, with a loupe that looks closer under the cursor, built with React and canvas.

items.name: hold-button
items.title: Hold Button
items.description: Press and hold to confirm, with a fill that drains back on early release and a drawn check on completion.

items.name: ink-background
items.title: Ink Background
items.description: A hero written in ink on water. Stir it and the letters bleed, drop ink with a click, and the headline gathers itself again, built with React, WebGL and a fluid simulation.

items.name: lightbox-grid
items.title: Lightbox Grid
items.description: A photo grid whose thumbnails grow into a full view and fly back to their slot when you drag them down.

items.name: liquid-gauge
items.title: Liquid Gauge
items.description: A usage meter filled with liquid that sloshes, ripples and bubbles, built with React and a wave simulation.

items.name: liquid-glass-card
items.title: Now Playing
items.description: Music card with a spinning disc you can grab and turn to scrub, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: liquid-slider
items.title: Liquid Slider
items.description: A vertical slider you fill like a glass, with a sloshing surface and rising bubbles.

items.name: loader
items.title: Loader
items.description: Animated loading indicator with rotating gradient rings, size variants and customizable title text. Built with React and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: location-picker
items.title: Location Picker
items.description: Set a pickup point the way ride apps do. Drag the map under a fixed pin; it lifts off its shadow, glides onto the nearest curb, drops, and the street rolls in.

items.name: marker-text
items.title: Marker Text
items.description: Hand-drawn highlights, underlines, circles, boxes and strikes that draw themselves in reading order when the text comes into view.

items.name: marking-menu
items.title: Marking Menu
items.description: A radial menu you hold to open or flick to pick blind, built with React and Motion.

items.name: metric-card
items.title: Metric Card
items.description: A revenue KPI card. Scrub a day, drag a range, or pick a segment; the number rolls, the line morphs and the breakdown follows.

items.name: morph-popover
items.title: Morph Popover
items.description: A button that grows into the form it opens, with its label sliding up to become the title, then shrinks into a confirmation.

items.name: morphic-navbar
items.title: Split Nav
items.description: Navigation bar that splits around the active link, with drag-to-scrub, flick projection and an optional compact fold.

items.name: notification-stack
items.title: Notification Stack
items.description: Stacked notifications that fan out on hover and swipe away, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: page-flip
items.title: Page Flip
items.description: A book you turn by the corner. Drag a page over the spine or tap to turn it.

items.name: particle-button
items.title: Particle Button
items.description: A status button for async actions, with a spinner, a drawn check and a particle burst on success.

items.name: photo-straighten
items.title: Photo Straighten
items.description: Level a crooked photo on a ruler you drag or flick. The crop grows to hide the corners, and a grid shows while you adjust.

items.name: plucked-text
items.title: Plucked Text
items.description: A headline sitting on a string you can pluck, strum and let ring, built with React and real string physics.

items.name: profile-dropdown
items.title: Account Menu
items.description: An account card that morphs into its own menu, with account switching, status, theme and hold-to-sign-out.

items.name: pull-cord
items.title: Pull Cord
items.description: A lamp switch you pull on a swinging cord, built with React and a rope simulation.

items.name: rain-glass-background
items.title: Rain Glass Background
items.description: A hero seen through a rainy window. Drops gather, run and swallow each other, each one a tiny lens showing the view, and dragging wipes the fog off the glass for a while.

items.name: receipt-printer
items.title: Receipt Printer
items.description: A receipt that prints line by line, then tears off and falls when you pull it, built with React.

items.name: save-button
items.title: Save Button
items.description: A bookmark button that files into collections. Tap to save to the last one, then change it or make a new one from the strip.

items.name: scroll-index
items.title: Scroll Index
items.description: A section rail for long pages, with a tick per heading that you can hover, click or drag to scrub, built with React.

items.name: seat-map
items.title: Seat Map
items.description: Pick seats for a show. Drag along a row to take several, and it points out any single seat you'd leave stranded.

items.name: shadow-text
items.title: Shadow Text
items.description: A headline that works as a sundial. Each letter casts a long, soft shadow set by the reader's clock, and bringing the pointer close turns it into a lamp.

items.name: shape-hero
items.title: Shape Hero
items.description: A landing hero where shapes drop in, pile up under the headline and can be grabbed and thrown.

items.name: signature-pad
items.title: Signature Pad
items.description: A signature field with a sprung pen tip, speed-weighted ink and SVG output.

items.name: slide-text-button
items.title: Slide Text Button
items.description: Animated link button with a vertical text slide on hover and default and ghost variants, built with React, Next.js Link, and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: slide-to-confirm
items.title: Slide to Confirm
items.description: A confirm control for payments and other actions you can't take back. Slide the thumb to the end, or flick it.

items.name: slot-picker
items.title: Slot Picker
items.description: Book a meeting on a real day rail. Click a free gap and drag the meeting; it hops over what's already booked, grows in place when you change the length, and shows the host's local time.

items.name: smooth-drawer
items.title: Smooth Drawer
items.description: Checkout bottom sheet on Vaul snap points, peeking at the total and dragging up for details.

items.name: smooth-tab
items.title: Swipe Tabs
items.description: Tabs with a swipeable panel, a drag-tracked indicator and spring physics.

items.name: spending-ring
items.title: Spending Ring
items.description: A spending breakdown you spin like a dial; flick the ring and it settles with a category under the marker.

items.name: split-flap-text
items.title: Split Flap Text
items.description: Departure-board lettering for launch headlines and status lines. Each tile flips through its drum only as far as its new letter, on a real hinge, a beat after its neighbour.

items.name: spoiler-text
items.title: Spoiler Text
items.description: Inline text hidden under drifting specks, like a chat spoiler. A click blows the specks away from the point you touched.

items.name: stack-panel
items.title: Stack Panel
items.description: A panel that drills into pages like settings on a phone. The tapped row's label flies up into the title, and a swipe right takes you back.

items.name: status-island
items.title: Status Island
items.description: A pill that reports background work, reshaping as tasks change and opening into a list of everything in flight.

items.name: stay-picker
items.title: Stay Picker
items.description: A date range for booking stays. Every night shows its price, sold-out nights are hatched, and your stay is drawn as one pill that wraps from week to week as you drag.

items.name: switch-button
items.title: Switch Button
items.description: Light and dark theme toggle whose sun folds into a moon while the new theme spreads from the button as a circle.

items.name: swoosh-text
items.title: Extruded Text
items.description: Zinc 3D extruded text lit by your pointer, with letters that press in like keycaps.

items.name: synced-transcript
items.title: Synced Transcript
items.description: A transcript that follows the spoken word, lets you click any word to jump there, and waits when you scroll away.

items.name: team-selector
items.title: Team Selector
items.description: Seat picker with a scrubbable number, generated avatars and an optional rolling price line.

items.name: tear-button
items.title: Tear Button
items.description: A confirm button you tear off like a ticket stub, hole by hole.

items.name: timezone-planner
items.title: Time Zone Planner
items.description: Find a meeting time across time zones. Turn the meeting round a 24-hour dial where each ring is someone's day.

items.name: tip-selector
items.title: Tip Selector
items.description: A tip picker for checkout, set on a tape you drag and flick. The ticks you pass fill in, the amounts roll, and Round up makes the total a whole amount.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Tool Dock
items.description: An editor tool dock with a sliding selection plate, shortcut tooltips and flyouts that you can throw to any edge.

items.name: topo-background
items.title: Topo Background
items.description: A living contour map that drifts, rises under the cursor and ripples on click, built with React and Canvas.

items.name: type-writer
items.title: Typing Text
items.description: Typewriter text that makes the odd typo and corrects it, erases by selecting, and blinks its caret only when idle, built with React and Motion.

items.name: undo-button
items.title: Undo Button
items.description: An action button that gives you a few seconds to take it back, with the time left drawn around its own edge.

items.name: uptime-card
items.title: Uptime Card
items.description: A status page card with 90 days per service that swell under the cursor, and a day you click opens its incident log.

items.name: v0-button
items.title: V0 Button
items.description: Open in v0 button that sends a component registry JSON to v0.dev for instant editing, built with React, the shadcn Button, and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: wheel-picker
items.title: Wheel Picker
items.description: iOS-style 3D drum picker with flick momentum, built with React and Motion.
